Analyzing the datasheet: transmitter rows pair models with `tx_power_min_dbm`; link-distance rows pair host interface, standard, and reach; receiver rows pair baud rate with `rx_sensitivity_dbm`. **Note:** `LxLx-ST11xx`, `Roughrider`, and `RR` are not given their own modes because the datasheet does not place them on a transmitter or link row with distinct electrical/optical values. `Fiber Channel`, `FC-PH`, `FC-PI-2`, and `ANSI X3.297` are not used where the link and receiver sections name **2x/1x Fiber Channel**, **FC-PI** / **FC-PH-2**, and **2.125** / **1.0625 Gbaud** with **−15** / **−17 dBm** sensitivity. No penalty objects were supplied. Crossing each ordered power SKU with each link-distance row follows the family product definition; if you require modes only from single table rows (no cross-table join), say so and the set can be reduced to four link-only or four TX-only modes.
